alt: parallelStream에 전달한 작업을 두 작업자가 처리하는 예시
requiredChecks: Developer supplies action, parallelStream runtime divides elements into two example workers.
Two workers each process three elements; illustrative workers, no fixed core/thread rule.
prompt: Create ONE original raster PNG technical educational diagram for a Korean IT blog. White opaque background, navy readable sans-serif text, flat blue/teal boxes, generous whitespace. Use only the exact subject and components below. No logos, watermark, decorative illustrations, unrelated graphs, extra numeric values or invented facts. Redesign composition rather than copy source. Every connection must be accurate and labels fully readable.  Title Parallel internal iteration. Developer action → parallelStream runtime → two parallel worker lanes labeled Worker A (example) and Worker B (example). Each lane three numbered elements: A has 1,2,3; B has 4,5,6, each with process arrow down. Caption Runtime distributes work; worker count and scheduling vary. No fixed assignment to physical cores, no guaranteed speedup.
